title: Construct compiler source roots and conditional header prefixes
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Implements the concrete pure enabling component returned by the completed compiler-input closure Pro consultation: exact six-source root/argv construction and a **conditional ordinary-header no-PCH first-match prefix**. It authenticates all six original role C/header occurrences, emits all 20 literal include obligations and preserves the unchanged list-valued GCC command. Independent executable controls retain corruption/no-op distinctions, negative-lookup and search-order cases, unsupported cases and a stale-facts counterexample.

**Partial compiler-input closure prerequisite only.** The function does not derive the installed compiler's effective search chain, authenticate supplied namespace facts, construct a genuine observer, or complete macro/specs/linker/loader closure. Full compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign, original controls, actual namespace/currentness, runtime qualification, complete costs and whole-activity credit remain open. A hash-bound report does not prove its assertions true.

Standing explicit user assignment: consult Pro, implement useful prerequisites and contribute after completed units; latest instruction publishes resolved questions and requests the compiler-input closure consultation. This is the accurately named new enabling unit from that completed response, not a resumed bootstrap-control campaign round or a narrowed full-family claim.

This PR adds executable pure enabling bodies and independent controls, rather than repeating those audits. Original lineage #6321/#6029/#5864 and separate #6339/#6346/#6347 scopes remain.
- The 6365-byte implementation exactly matches Pro's returned SHA256 `438cdc6c8b003d9a1b6a41889d6ac2f3d5bed25f77b430cf3b5f63c36c4e4612`. Codex did not alter it. Pro reports a separate agent review with repairs; Codex independently reviewed the returned source and constructed its own controls.
- The exact original helper at SHA256 `aa0a315110e031e19291970c9611fe5e0f91465fa20eaec51e81186099563f78` is newly retained as inert text. Its sole Popen call supplies neither env nor cwd; actual inherited caller context remains unqualified. This input was found after the completed Pro response.
- Scope changed from the retained portable-replay card to the explicit fixed-source compiler-input closure enabling assignment. The original source/configuration/gates are preserved.

## Validation

Executed on Python 3.12.3:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-source-roots --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-source-roots
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-c05-source-roots
```

Metadata/pins and registered normal/optimized replay pass. Each mode reports `controls=53 project_paths=6 literal_sites=20 stale_facts_counterexample=1 full_C05=false runtime_qualified=false`. Independent expected argv is derived from the original producer AST, and the site oracle separately enumerates all fixed-source literal directives. Controls cover all six byte corruptions, distinct-header swap refusal, equal-content positives, exact argument/path/mode domains, missing earlier observations, earlier winners, search-order changes, unsupported PCH/alias/error outcomes, malformed unused suffixes and the preserved stale-data limitation.

The 19-file committed-byte preflight passed. Exact remote branch, tree and sole canonical parent are verified. Hosted checks are pending at submission. A metadata preparation refusal for the required Open next questions heading was corrected without changing implementation, fixtures or controls; no functional source repair was needed.

Only the **new pure implementation** is executed. Archived producer/helper are parsed as AST and original C/header payloads are inert bytes; no Root/provider/producer/helper execution, native build, compiler diagnostic, original control or real namespace observer is run. The finite namespace inputs are explicitly data, not a fake Root/owner/syscall observation.

`DOMAIN-ARGUMENT.md` states the conditional induction and all external premises. Supplied mode labels and required 0444 values are not flag/stat observations. The new selection markers remain None and are not guards preventing pure testing; original execution/admission gates are untouched. Local component bounds do not redefine compiler-input closure or increase original limits. Unknown physical/preparation/review/publication/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.
